title: Pointer to the properties of the inverse image
text:
In the notation of [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], the following holds. That
$u^{-1}$ is exact, that it therefore acts termwise on complexes, and that it
induces the derived adjunction $u^{-1}\dashv Ru_*$ on the derived categories
[def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] $\Dplus$ are
[prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-exact] and
*Derived adjunction of inverse image*.
